cards.lore: The original intelligence state. They invented the bond market and the secret police in the same afternoon.
cards.power: Council of Ten: Look at the top 3 cards of the deck. Keep the secrets, bury the rest.

cards.lore: Titles survive when nations fall. We wear black because we are mourning the loss of our visible power. The invisible kind pays better.
cards.power: Lateran Treaty: Move any amount of Damage tokens from your Actor to an offshore discard pile.

cards.lore: God's accountant. Sovereign immunity is the ultimate money laundering app.
cards.power: Old Money: You cannot be targeted by 'Financial' effects. You were rich before the currency existed.

cards.lore: The City of London's eyes in the House of Commons. Democracy is fine, as long as the bond market gets a vote.
cards.power: The Square Mile: Veto any rule change that affects the Economy suit.

cards.lore: Rhodes Scholar. We don't want to rule the world; we just want to federally unite the English-speaking peoples to manage it for you.
cards.power: Scholarship Pipeline: Search the deck for an 'Elite' card and put it into your hand.

cards.lore: The Council on Foreign Relations. The school for statesmen. If you aren't on the list, you don't exist.
cards.power: Foreign Affairs: Force two other players to swap hands. They are now aligned.

cards.lore: The Rockefeller Foundation. We standardized medicine, education, and agriculture. You're welcome.
cards.power: Social Engineering: Change the current Quest Goal to match your Agenda.

cards.lore: Once I worked for the bad guys. Now I work for the good guys. The rockets go up regardless of where they come down.
cards.power: Wernher's Ambition: +2 to all 'Tech' rolls. Ignore 'Moral' penalties.

cards.lore: Allen Dulles. I run the agency, my brother runs the State Dept, and we represent the banks. Any questions?
cards.power: Coup D'etat: Overthrow the current Stage Leader. Replace their card with yours.

cards.lore: We just want to see what happens if we erase a mind. For national security, obviously.
cards.power: Depatterning: Target player discards their hand and draws 3 new cards. They forget who they were.

cards.lore: Stay behind. When the Soviets invade, we'll be ready. Until then, we'll just blow up train stations to keep you alert.
cards.power: Strategy of Tension: Add 1 Chaos Token to the Stage every turn.

cards.lore: The CIA owns everyone of any significance in the major media. We don't write copy; we suggest the emphasis.
cards.power: Editorial Control: Cancel an opponent's 'Narrative' action. Call it disinformation.

cards.lore: The Federal Reserve. Neither Federal, nor a Reserve. I print, therefore I am.
cards.power: Quantitative Easing: Give every player 2 cards. Inflation makes them worth less later.

cards.lore: The Bank for International Settlements. The central bank for central banks. Nazi gold or Allied gold, it all spends the same.
cards.power: Sovereign Shield: You cannot be sued, audited, or inspected. Ignore all 'Law' effects.

cards.lore: Catherine Austin Fitts: $21 Trillion in undocumentable adjustments? I have questions about the plumbing.
cards.power: Follow the Money: Reveal target player's Hidden Agenda. If it involves fraud, they lose a turn.

cards.lore: Weaponized interbank messaging. Nice economy you have there. Be a shame if someone disconnected it.
cards.power: Sanctions Regime: Target player cannot draw cards (assets frozen) for one turn.

cards.lore: CIA Director, VP, President. I can't recall where I was that day in Dallas. The memory is a tricky thing.
cards.power: Pardon Power: Cancel any 'Investigation' or 'Indictment' card played against you.

cards.lore: The Clinton Network. Tough on crime, easy on banks. I feel your pain, but I'll take that donation.
cards.power: Access Middleware: Trade Influence for Cash. Discard 1 card to gain +2 Influence.

cards.lore: I was a hero once. Then I met a financier. Now I don't recall meeting the girl. Mummy paid the settlement.
cards.power: Royal Exit: If targeted by 'Scandal,' vanish from play. Return next turn with no memory.

cards.lore: I write the rules for the bank I will work for next year. It's not corruption; it's career planning.
cards.power: Capture: Play a card from the discard pile as if it were your own.

cards.lore: Epstein. I collect people. Scientists, princes, politicians. Everyone has a vice. I just provide the venue.
cards.power: The Black Book: Look at target player's hand. Choose one card they must play next.

cards.lore: Maxwell. You need an introduction? I know everyone. Just don't ask who my father worked for.
cards.power: Grooming: Steal an Ally card from another player. They now work for you.

cards.lore: The oldest trick in the book. Love is fleeting. The photos are forever.
cards.power: Kompromat: Place a 'Blackmail' token on a player. They cannot attack you until they pay the ransom.

cards.lore: Non-prosecution agreement. I belong to intelligence. Leave it alone.
cards.power: Immunity: Negate a 'Prison' effect. Walk free.

cards.lore: We built the payment rails, then we built the surveillance state, then we built the rockets to leave.
cards.power: Libertarian Exit: Ignore all 'Government' rules. Create your own currency.

cards.lore: Aladdin. The market isn't free; it's managed by my risk parameters. I own the underlying assets of the world.
cards.power: Asset Management: Control the next Quest. Swap any two Stage cards.

cards.lore: The operating system for the deep state. We know where the terrorists are. And your next purchase from Amazon.
cards.power: Total Awareness: Predict the next Quest roll. (Or roll to a number of your choice).

cards.lore: You will own nothing and be happy. It is inevitable. The Fourth Industrial Revolution requires us.
cards.power: Stakeholder Capitalism: Redistribute all players' hands evenly. Reset the game state.

cards.lore: Non-human biologics. The craft are bigger on the inside. I am under oath.
cards.power: Disclosure: Reveal the top card of the 'Truth' deck. Everyone loses 1 Sanity.

cards.lore: Admiral Byrd saw something. Why do all the elites visit the ice? Nothing to see here but snow.
cards.power: Hollow Earth: Escape to a secret zone. You are immune to global events for 1 round.

cards.lore: We have technology 50 years ahead of you. Why would we share it? We're leaving.
cards.power: Zero Point Energy: Your actions cost 0 Energy this turn.

cards.lore: Is it aliens? Or is it a holographic projection to scare you into global government? Why not both?
cards.power: Blue Beam: Convince the table that a 'FAKE' threat is real. All players must discard a Resource to fight it.

cards.lore: Nobody saw it coming. Except the people who shorted the airline stocks the day before.
cards.power: Put Option: If the Quest fails, you gain triple rewards.

cards.lore: Building 7. It fell symmetrically. Fires don't do that. Physics took a day off.
cards.power: Pull It: Destroy one Location card instantly. No resistance.

cards.lore: We practiced this months before it happened. Just a coincidence. Put your mask on.
cards.power: Lockdown: No player can move or trade for one round. Essential workers only.

cards.lore: One bullet, seven wounds. The Warren Commission says I'm a lone gunman. I'm just a bug.
cards.power: Lone Wolf: Eliminate a target. No conspiracy required. (Terms and conditions apply).

cards.lore: I connect the dots! The Pizza! The Lizards! The Water Filter! It all makes sense at 3 AM.
cards.power: Pattern Recognition: Link two unrelated cards. They now share a Power.

cards.lore: The mainstream media is a script. I read the documents they threw away. Here's the receipts.
cards.power: Substack: Bypass the 'Censor.' Your message reaches all players.

cards.lore: Freedom of Information. I'll get you the truth. In 75 years. With black ink over the good parts.
cards.power: Slow Drip: Reveal one secret card after a 3-turn delay.

cards.lore: We can't outspend them. But we can make them look ridiculous. Magic is just focused intent.
cards.power: Viral Hit: Your narrative overrides the Official Story. +2 Influence.

cards.lore: Show me the man and I'll show you the crime. Process is the punishment.
cards.power: Indictment: Target player spends their next turn in 'Court.' No actions allowed.

cards.lore: I show you what makes you angry. Anger keeps you clicking. Clicking makes money.
cards.power: Shadowban: Target player's voice is silenced. They cannot speak during the Negotiation Phase.

cards.lore: Admit the small crime to cover the big one. 'Yes, we spied on you. But only to catch bad guys.'
cards.power: Partial Disclosure: Reveal a minor secret to protect a major one.

cards.lore: Behavioral psychology. We don't force you. We just design the choice architecture so you obey.
cards.power: Default Setting: Change the rules. Players must opt-out to avoid the effect.

cards.lore: A thought-form created by collective belief. The monster exists because you all believe in it.
cards.power: Groupthink: If the majority votes for a reality, it becomes True, even if it contradicts the cards.

cards.lore: You behave because you might be watched. The jailer is in your head.
cards.power: Self-Censor: Players must reveal their hands. There are no secrets.

cards.lore: The god of coordination failure. We do what none of us want, because we can't trust each other.
cards.power: Race to the Bottom: All players sacrifice 1 Resource. If anyone refuses, everyone loses 2.

cards.lore: Move the window. What was unthinkable yesterday is policy today. What is sensible is now hate speech.
cards.power: Shift: Move the 'Acceptable' range of the die roll.

cards.lore: Biology is a limitation. Merge with the machine. Live forever in the cloud. Terms of Service apply.
cards.power: Neuralink: Upload your hand to the 'Cloud' (Deck). Draw a digital copy.

cards.lore: You bought the wrong beer. You walked against the light. Your train ticket is denied.
cards.power: Compliance: You cannot act unless your Reputation is above 5.

cards.lore: New Zealand. Hawaii. We have a plan for when the SHTF. You are not on the guest list.
cards.power: Exit Strategy: Avoid 'Game Over,' if the table flips, you survive.

cards.lore: The point where the graph goes vertical. Afterward? Who knows. Probably paperclips.
cards.power: Event Horizon: The game ends in 3 turns. Whoever has the most Tech wins.
